title: Homelab health overview
description: High-level health of every host: k8s0, Proxmox, TrueNAS, connector0, gw0, nexus-kb and gitlab0. Node Exporter has every metric.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One row per host. Click a host to select it below. Failed units only exist on systemd hosts, and temperatures only where the kernel exposes sensors.

targets.expr: count by (instance) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity=~"warning|critical"}) and on (instance) up{job="node-exporter"}

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Excludes reclaimable page cache. On TrueNAS the ZFS ARC counts as used.

panels.title: Root filesystem
panels.description: / on most hosts; /var on Talos (k8s0), where / is read-only.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of all cores. High iowait means processes wait on disks; steal means the hypervisor is busy.

panels.title: Pressure stall (PSI)
panels.description: Share of time some task waited for CPU, memory or IO. Sustained memory or io pressure is the earliest sign of a struggling host.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: The forecast extends the last 6 hours' trend by one day. On ZFS each dataset's free space is its pool's.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each disk had IO in flight. Near 100% means the disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: Empty is good: only non-zero rates are drawn.

panels.title: Disk health
panels.description: TrueNAS drives from smartctl_exporter, Proxmox NVMe drives from the textfile collector (refreshed every 15 minutes). Health is the SMART verdict, or for NVMe no critical warning; Critical warning is the raw NVMe bitmask (0 is healthy). Columns no disk on this host reports are left out. CRC errors point at cables, not the disk.

targets.expr: (max by (device, model) (label_replace(smartctl_device{instance="$instance"}, "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.*)")) or max by (device, model) (nvme_device_info{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device, serial) (label_replace(smartctl_device{instance="$instance"}, "serial", "$1", "serial_number", "(.*)")) or max by (device, serial) (nvme_device_info{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{instance="$instance"}) or max by (device) (nvme_critical_warning{instance="$instance"} == bool 0)) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_temperature{instance="$instance", temperature_type="current"}) or max by (device) (nvme_temperature_celsius{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{instance="$instance"}) or max by (device) (nvme_power_on_hours_total{instance="$instance"}) * 3600) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{instance="$instance"}) / 100 or max by (device) (nvme_percentage_used_ratio{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_available_spare{instance="$instance"}) / 100 or max by (device) (nvme_available_spare_ratio{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_media_errors{instance="$instance"}) or max by (device) (nvme_media_errors_total{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance="$instance", attribute_name="Reallocated_Sector_Ct", attribute_value_type="raw"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance="$instance", attribute_name="Current_Pending_Sector", attribute_value_type="raw"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance="$instance", attribute_name="Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_attribute{instance="$instance", attribute_name="UDMA_CRC_Error_Count", attribute_value_type="raw"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

(max by (device) (smartctl_device_critical_warning{instance="$instance"}) or max by (device) (nvme_critical_warning{instance="$instance"})) unless on (device) smartctl_device{instance="$instance", scsi_vendor="QEMU"}

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Journal entries with priority warning or worse. k8s0 has no node journal yet; its pod logs are below.

panels.title: All logs
panels.description: The host's journal, or on k8s0 the logs of pods on the node. Narrow it with the Search box.
